comment_id.description: Unique comment identifier from the supplied CSV.

labels.NEGATIVE: Complaint, dissatisfaction, frustration or criticism; interpret sarcasm by intended meaning.
labels.NEUTRAL: Question, inquiry or factual observation without strong emotional tone.
labels.POSITIVE: Clear satisfaction, appreciation or gratitude toward teaching, course or platform.

category.description: One or two aspect categories, separated by a pipe with surrounding spaces.

acsa.description: Six category-specific sentiment slots. Absent indicates a category not addressed. The CSV preserves its original title-case labels.

labels.Negative: Complaint, dissatisfaction, frustration or criticism; interpret sarcasm by intended meaning.
labels.Neutral: Question, inquiry or factual observation without strong emotional tone.
labels.Positive: Clear satisfaction, appreciation or gratitude toward teaching, course or platform.
labels.Absent: Aspect not addressed; exclude from gold-present ACSA evaluation.

acsa_Academic.definition: Teaching style, concept clarity and course structure.

acsa_Community.definition: Peer recommendations, enrollment queries and platform comparisons.

acsa_Praise.definition: Appreciation or thanks where praise is the dominant purpose.

acsa_Technical.definition: App bugs, video buffering, login failures and payment errors.

acsa_Support.definition: Customer support, refund disputes and trust in management.

acsa_Troll.definition: Off-topic attacks, inflammatory comparisons and provocation.

acsa.single_category_rule: The present aspect inherits the sentence sentiment.
acsa.dual_category_rule: Annotate polarity separately for each present aspect.
